findings.description: The requirement combines treatment of a start delay equal to its limit with treatment of an execution time equal to its limit. Either behavior could pass while the other fails.
findings.requested_change: State the equality behavior for start delay and execution time as separately verifiable obligations.

findings.description: The requirement combines detection of a start-delay violation with detection of an execution-time violation. Either detection can meet the deadline while the other fails.
findings.requested_change: Separate the detection deadline into independently verifiable obligations for start delay and execution time, or consolidate each with its corresponding fault-detection requirement.
